offers.title: Dream Big Sleep Mask
offers.blurb: A weighted, contoured sleep mask for deeper rest and vivid dreaming.
offers.why: James's own — made to help you actually drop into sleep, not just block light.
offers.creator: Dream Big
offers.helps_grow: Deep, uninterrupted sleep — and the calm nervous system that good rest builds.
for_who: Light sleepers and anyone who wakes at 3am
People whose minds race at night
Meditators who want total darkness for practice
not_for: Anyone hoping a mask alone fixes deeper sleep issues — pair it with a real wind-down
Side sleepers who dislike any pressure near the eyes
offers.why_selected: It's James's own — made because most masks leak light, slide off, or press your eyes. This one is contoured and weighted to actually stay, block fully, and feel calming.
how_to_use: Slip it on, adjust the strap once
Three slow breaths — let the dark do the rest
reasons_not_to_buy: If your room is already pitch black and you sleep fine — you don't need this
If your sleep problem is stress or caffeine, fix that first (the Guide can help)

offers.title: Zen Village Retreat · Costa Rica
offers.blurb: A real-world gathering at Camp Zen — nervous-system repair, conscious community, jungle presence.
offers.why: The physical home of everything Full Potential points toward.
offers.creator: Zen Village
offers.helps_grow: Nervous-system repair, real community, and presence — the things a screen can't give you.
for_who: Anyone running on empty who needs a true reset
People craving conscious community, not a vacation
Builders and founders who need to slow down to speed up
not_for: Anyone looking for a party or a luxury resort — this is a practice container
offers.why_selected: It's the physical home of everything Full Potential points toward — the place the philosophy becomes a body in a hammock in the jungle.
how_to_use: Pick dates that let you fully unplug
Come with one question you're sitting with
Leave space after — integration is part of it
reasons_not_to_buy: If you can't take a real break right now, wait until you can be all-in
